newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says troops kill Hizbollah gunman in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel says troops kill Hizbollah gunman in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli troops killed a Hizbollah gunman and wounded others during an exchange of fire in the Jewish state's self-declared south Lebanon security zone, the Israeli military said on Wednesday.

"An Israeli army force that was on an operational activity in the central sector of the security zone in south Lebanon was intercepted by a terrorist unit of the Hizbollah organisation and killed at least one terrorist and wounded several more," a statement said.

"There were no injuries to our forces," it added. It said that during the exchange, the guerrillas fired mortars and light weapons from Kabriha village at Israeli and allied South Lebanon Army militia forces.
On Tuesday, Israeli planes attacked suspected Hizbollah targets in the Syrian-controlled eastern Bekaa Valley, security sources said. It was Israel's 26th air attack against Lebanon this year.
Shortly after the air raid on Tuesday, Hizbollah, the pro-Iranian Party of God, issued a statement saying its guerrillas had attacked a motorised patrol and an outpost of the SLA.
Pro-Israeli militia sources inside the zone said no one was injured in either of those attacks.

Hizbollah guerrillas frequently attack Israeli troops in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone set up in the south to prevent attacks on Israel's northern border communities.
